title: Model run analytics
responsibility: Defines the versioned Tracker and Harness run record, estimates standard API token cost and compares run reliability and cost.

inputs.name: estimateApiCost.model
inputs.description: The exact provider model ID, used to look up published standard global token rates.

inputs.name: estimateApiCost.usage
inputs.description: Canonical input and output counts, known cache read and write counts, and any CLI-reported API-equivalent estimate.

inputs.name: classifyTaskType.title
inputs.description: Task title matched against shared task type patterns before looking at task notes.

inputs.name: classifyTaskType.notes
inputs.description: Optional task notes examined when no pattern matches the title.

inputs.name: classifyTaskType.fallback
inputs.description: Task type used when neither the title nor the notes match a pattern.

inputs.name: difficultyForFiles.files
inputs.description: Count of declared or changed paths, or null when the count could not be observed.

inputs.name: createRunRecord.input
inputs.description: Source identity, task metadata, timing, outcome, difficulty, token usage and attributable costs for one run.

inputs.name: summarizeModelRuns.records
inputs.description: Run records to deduplicate by ID before calculating summaries and weekly trends.

inputs.name: recommendModels.records
inputs.description: Run records from which to rank priced first attempts with observable outcomes.

inputs.name: recommendModels.minSamples
inputs.description: Minimum number of priced first attempts required to qualify a model and effort.

inputs.name: recommendModels.reliability
inputs.description: Minimum fraction of successful first attempts required to qualify.

inputs.name: recommendModels.allCandidates
inputs.description: When true, include every qualifying configuration in cost order.

outputs.name: RUN_SCHEMA_VERSION
outputs.description: Version attached to the portable run record.

outputs.name: RATE_CARD
outputs.description: Version of the published rate card used for a new estimate.

outputs.name: estimateApiCost
outputs.description: Exact amount or range in USD with its pricing source and basis. Amounts remain null for unavailable pricing.

outputs.name: classifyTaskType
outputs.description: First recognized task type or the caller’s fallback.

outputs.name: difficultyForFiles
outputs.description: Small for at most two paths, medium for three to eight, large above eight, and null when the count is missing.

outputs.name: createRunRecord
outputs.description: A versioned run record with normalized usage, API cost bounds and any independently attributable charges.

outputs.name: summarizeModelRuns
outputs.description: Model and effort rows, task type totals, weekly rows and first-attempt recommendations.

outputs.name: recommendModels
outputs.description: Qualifying model and effort rows ranked by the upper API-equivalent cost per successful task.
